cases.sentence: Когда царица Шевы услышала о славе Соломона, она пришла в Иерусалим, чтобы испытать его ___.
cases.explain: «трудными вопросами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

cases.sentence: Она подарила царю сто двадцать талантов золота, великое множество пряностей и ___.
cases.explain: «драгоценных камней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

cases.sentence: Еще они привезли красное дерево и ___.
cases.explain: «драгоценные камни» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

cases.sentence: Царь сделал из ___ лестницы для Господнего дома и для царского дворца, а также арфы и лиры для музыкантов.
cases.explain: «красного дерева» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

cases.sentence: Царь сделал из красного дерева лестницы для Господнего дома и для ___, а также арфы и лиры для музыкантов.

cases.translation: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

cases.sentence: Царь Соломон сделал двести ___ из кованого золота, на каждый из которых пошло по шестисот бека золота.
cases.explain: «больших щитов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler.

cases.explain: «маленьких щитов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

cases.explain: «Ливанского леса» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

cases.sentence: Еще царь сделал ___, выложенный слоновой костью и покрытый чистым золотом.
cases.explain: «огромный трон» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

cases.explain: «чистым золотом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.

cases.sentence: Никогда ничего подобного не делалось ни в каком ___.
cases.explain: «другом царстве» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

cases.sentence: Все чаши царя Соломона были золотыми, и вся домашняя утварь во дворце ___ была из чистого золота.
cases.explain: «Ливанского леса» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

cases.sentence: Все чаши царя Соломона были золотыми, и вся домашняя утварь во дворце Ливанского леса была из ___.
cases.explain: «чистого золота» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: All king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

cases.sentence: На море у царя был флот из ___, с командой из слуг Хирама.
cases.explain: «таршишских кораблей» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

cases.sentence: У Соломона было четыре тысячи стойл для коней и колесниц и двенадцать тысяч коней , которых он держал в ___ и у себя, в Иерусалиме.
cases.explain: «колесничных городах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he stationed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

cases.sentence: Он правил всеми царями от Реки до земли филистимлян, до ___ Египта.
cases.explain: «самой границы» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

cases.sentence: В его правление серебро в Иерусалиме ценилось не выше ___, а кедра было так же много, как тутовых деревьев в предгорьях Иудеи.
cases.explain: «простых камней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

cases.sentence: Кони Соломона поставлялись из Египта и из ___.
cases.explain: «других стран» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

cases.sentence: А ___ правления Соломона, от первых до последних, то разве не описаны они в записях пророка Нафана, в пророчестве Ахии из Шило и в видениях провидца Иддо о Иеровоаме, сыне Навата?
cases.explain: «прочие события» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
